correctness.rationale: Reviewed RESULT.md:5–56, VERIFICATION.md, and checks/check_extremizers.py. Positivity and the order-unit norm make the same unit vector norm all powers, including in the complex case by the lattice modulus inequality. Hence the optimum absolute Cesàro constant is the supremum of the prefix averages of a_j = ||T^j||. For each j between 0 and n, submultiplicativity gives a_j a_(n-j) >= a_n; AM–GM summed over j gives (n+1)sqrt(a_n) <= sum a_j <= (n+1)K. This includes zero powers and n=0. The finite backward shift with endpoint weights c and interior weights 1 has powers with norms 1, c (N−1 terms), c², then zero. The largest prefix average includes c² and equals c+(c−1)²/(N+1). For each exact K>1 the tuning equation has one c_N>1 by strict monotonicity and unboundedness in c, and 0<K−c_N<=(K−1)²/(N+1); thus c_N² tends to K². K=1 is attained by the identity. Independent bounded replay: python3 /workspace/branches/replay_frozen_review.py 2 checked 16 exact rational matrix orbits using basis vectors and row sums. That tests the construction, not the infinite-dimensional inequality or the quantifier over real K; these are proved algebraically.
